fields.description: Lwaki Yesu yafiira ku musaalaba? Ebyawandiikibwa biwa eby’okuddamu ebikwataganye — yafa mu kifo kyaffe, obwenkanya bwa Katonda ne butuukirizibwa, okwagala kwe ne kweyoleka, n’abasibe ne basumululwa — era byonna awamu bikola ekintu kimu ekimasamasa.
fields.body_html:
Wakati mu kukkiriza kw’Ekikristaayo wayimiriddewo omusaalaba — ekintu ekyakozesebwanga okutta abantu, ate ne kifuuka akabonero k’essuubi eri ensi. Kya kyewuunyo okuzimba eddiini ku kufa kw’oyo eyagitandikawo, era kya kyewuunyo n’okusingawo okuyita olunaku lwe yafiirako nti “Lwakutaano Olulungi.” Naye Abakristaayo bulijjo bakkaatiriza nti okufa kwa Yesu tekwali kibonoobono oba kabenje, wabula kye kigendererwa kyennyini kye yajjira, ekikolwa ky’okwagala ekisingayo obuziba mu byafaayo, era omulamwa obulokozi bw’ensi kwe bwesigamye. Kale lwaki Yesu yafa? Si lwa kuba nti abantu ababi baamutta kyokka, wadde nga ddala baamutta, wabula kubanga yasalawo okuwaayo obulamu bwe okutununula. “Omwana w’Omuntu, teyajja ku nsi kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza abalala, era n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.” (Makko 10:45).

Ebyawandiikibwa biwa eby’okuddamu ebiwerako ebikwataganye ku kibuuzo ekyo, era byonna awamu bikola ekintu kimu ekimasamasa. Zino ze nsonga lwaki omusaalaba guli mu mutima gwa buli kimu.

Yafa mu kifo kyaffe, ng’asitudde ekibi kyaffe

Eky’okuddamu ekisooka era ekisingayo obuziba kiri nti Yesu yafa mu kifo kyaffe — ne yeetikka omusango ekibi kyaffe gwe kyali kitusaanyiza. Ebyasa bingi ng’omusaalaba tegunnabaawo, Isaaya yakiraba: “yafumitibwa olw’okusobya kwaffe. Yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwaffe. Yeetikka ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe. Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya. Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga … Mukama n’amuteekako obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna.” (Isaaya 53:5-6). Yayimirira mu kifo mwe twandiyimiridde, ne yeetikka bye twandyetisse.

Peetero ayogera kye kimu, mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka: “Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba” (1 Peetero 2:24). Ne Pawulo ayogera ku nkyukakyuka eyo ennene mu ngeri esinga obwogi: “Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:21). Kino kye kyewuunyo ekiri mu mutima gw’omusaalaba — ekibi kyaffe kyabalibwa ku ye, n’obutuukirivu bwe ne bubalibwa ku ffe. Yatwala omusango gwaffe; ffe ne tufuna ekifo kye mu maaso ga Katonda.

Yafa okutuukiriza obwenkanya bwa Katonda n’okututabaganya ne Katonda

Lwaki Katonda teyandibuusizza buusa maaso kibi kyaffe awatali musaalaba? Kubanga Katonda wa bwenkanya, era obwenkanya tebuyinza kuziba maaso ku bubi, nga bwe kitasoboka omulamuzi omulungi okusuulirira obutemu. Ekibi kya ddala, era kireeta ebbanja lya ddala: “Era mu mateeka buli kintu kitukuzibwa na musaayi, era awatali kuyiwa musaayi tewabaawo kusonyiyibwa.” (Abaebbulaniya 9:22). Amawulire ag’enjiri ageewuunyisa gali nti Katonda teyakoma ku kulagira bbanja eryo lisasulwe; yalisasula yekka, mu Mwana we. “Katonda yaweereza Kristo okuba omutango, bwe tukkiriza Kristo olw’omusaayi gwe yayiwa” (Abaruumi 3:25) — kwe kugamba, nga ssaddaaka eggyawo obusungu obw’obwenkanya ekibi kyaffe bwe kyali kitusaanyizza.

Ekivaamu kwe kutabaganya: abalabe ne bafuuka mikwano, n’abaali ewala ne basembezebwa. “Kristo yabonyaabonyezebwa olw’ebibi omulundi gumu, Omuntu Omutuukirivu ku lw’abatali batuukirivu, alyoke abaleete eri Katonda” (1 Peetero 3:18). Ebigambo ebyo ebisembayo bye biraga ensonga yonna — alyoke abaleete eri Katonda. Omusaalaba tegukoma ku kusazaamu kibonerezo; guggulawo oluggi, ne guzzaawo enkolagana gye twatondebwa okubeeramu. E Gologoosa, okusaasira n’obwenkanya bisisinkana ne binywegeragana: Katonda alagibwa nga wa bwenkanya, ate nga y’oyo awa obutuukirivu oyo akkiriza Yesu. “Kino kiraga Katonda bw’alaga okwaniriza kw’alina eri abantu mu biro bino, bwe baba n’okukkiriza mu Yesu.” (Abaruumi 3:26).

Yafa kubanga yatwagala

Emabega w’enjigiriza eno waliwo omutima ogukuba. Okusinga byonna, omusaalaba kye kipimo ky’okwagala kwa Katonda. “Katonda alaga okwagala kwe gye tuli mu ngeri eno: bwe twali tukyali boonoonyi, Kristo n’atufiirira.” (Abaruumi 5:8). Teyalinda ffe kusooka kufuuka ba kwagalibwa; yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lwaffe nga tuli mu mbeera yaffe esinga obubi. Olunyiriri olusinga okumanyika mu Bayibuli luteeka okufa kwa Yesu munda mu kwagala kwa Katonda: “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.” (Yokaana 3:16).

Era okwagala kuno kwasalibwawo mu ddembe, tekwawalirizibwa. Yesu teyali muntu atalina maanyi eyawambibwa ebyaliwo; yali Omusumba Omulungi eyawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw’endiga mu bugenderevu. Yagamba nti “mpaayo obulamu bwange ndyoke mbweddize. Tewali n’omu abunzigyako, wabula mbuwaayo lwa kwagala kwange.” (Yokaana 10:17-18). Si misumaali gye gyamukuumira ku musaalaba; kwali kwagala. Bwe tutunuulira Kalvari, tuba tulaba Katonda bwe yali mwetegefu okutuuka ewala okutuddiza gy’ali.

Yafa okutusumulula

Omusaalaba era kwe kununulibwa — okusumululwa okuva mu buyinza bwe tutandisobodde kumenya ku lwaffe. Twali wansi w’ekikolimo ky’amateeka agaamenyebwa, era “Kristo yatununula okuva mu kikolimo ky’amateeka, bwe yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe” (Abaggalatiya 3:13). Twali baddu b’ekibi, naye ye Kristo “eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna, era yeerongooseza eggwanga ery’envuma” (Tito 2:14). Ekigambo omutango Yesu kye yakozesa ng’ayogera ku kufa kwe kitegeeza omuwendo ogusasulwa okusumulula omusibe.

Kale okufa kwa Kristo tekukoma ku kukola ku musango gwaffe; kumenya enjegere zaffe. Kutusumulula okuva mu kibonerezo ky’ekibi, okuva mu buyinza bwakyo, era olunaku lumu ne mu kubeerawo kwakyo kwennyini. Eno y’ensonga lwaki Endagaano Empya eyogera ku musaalaba si ng’okuwangulwa wabula ng’obuwanguzi — ekifo, mu ngeri eyewuunyisa, amaanyi g’ekizikiza we gaanyagibwako ebyokulwanyisa ne gaswazibwa mu lwatu. Ekyalabika ng’essaawa y’ensi esinga ekizikiza mu butuufu bwali buwanguzi bwa Katonda obusalawo byonna.

Omusaalaba gulaga ekibi bwe kiri eky’akabi ddala

Bwe tuba nga twebuuza oba ekibi kintu kitono, omusaalaba gumalawo ekibuuzo ekyo emirembe gyonna. Tunuulira ekyetaagisa okukola ku kibi kyaffe, olwo ojja kulaba amangu ago nti ekibi kiteekwa okuba eky’akabi ennyo. Tekyasobola kuggyibwawo lwa kuwuuba buwuubi mukono; kyetaagisa okufa kw’Omwana wa Katonda. “Empeera y’ekibi kwe kufa” (Abaruumi 6:23), era empeera eyo yasasulirwa e Kalvari — Kristo ye yagisasula, mu kifo kyaffe. Omusaalaba kye kipimo ky’obubi bw’embeera yaffe era n’obunene bw’okwagala kwa Katonda; byombi bibikkulirwa wamu, kubanga ekizikiza ky’ekibi kyaffe kye kibeera emabega, okwakaayakana kw’okusaasira kwe ne kulabikira ku kyo.

Kino kitukuuma obutatwala ng’ekintu ekyangu ekibi ekyo kyennyini Yesu kye yafiira okuggyawo. Omukkiriza ategeera ddala omusaalaba tasobola kuzannyira ku kintu ekyakomerera Omulokozi ku gwo. Naye omukkiriza oyo yennyini asumululwa okuva mu kusalirwa omusango kwonna, kubanga ekibonerezo kyetikkiddwa kyonna. Okutunuulira omusaalaba mu ngeri entuufu kwe kukyawa ekibi okusingawo n’okutya okusalirwa omusango okukendeerako — byombi omulundi gumu.

Entaana enjereere ejjuliza omusaalaba

Mu Ndagaano Empya, okufa kwa Yesu tekubuulirwa kwokka; bulijjo kugattibwa ku kuzuukira kwe. Omusaalaba gwasasula ebbanja, n’entaana enjereere ye risiiti ya Katonda — okulangirira kwe mu lwatu nti okusasula kwakkirizibwa era nti omulimu guwedde. “Kristo yaweebwayo okuttibwa olw’ebibi byaffe, n’azuukizibwa tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu.” (Abaruumi 4:25). Singa yasigala mu ntaana, tetwandisobodde kumanya nti okufa n’ekibi byawangulwa ddala; naye yazuukira. Pawulo agamba nti “obanga Kristo teyazuukizibwa okukkiriza kwammwe tekuliimu nsa, era mukyali mu bibi byammwe.” (1 Abakkolinso 15:17) — naye yazuukizibwa, n’olwekyo okukkiriza kwaffe kulimu ensa, n’ebibi byaffe biweddewo.

Eno y’ensonga lwaki Abakristaayo banakuwala ku musaalaba ate ne basanyuka: Omulokozi eyakomererwa ye Mukama eyazuukira. Oyo eyatufiirira akyali mulamu ku lwaffe: ayinza okulokolera ddala abo be yagula, “kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza” (Abaebbulaniya 7:25). Emboozi tekoma ku ntaana wabula ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka, n’ebiwundu ebyatulokola kati biwundu bya Kabaka omulamu era afuga.

Okufa kwe kumala — eri ensi yonna, era naawe

Waliwo amazima amalala agamu agatukuuma obutalowooza nti omusaalaba tegumala. Okufa kwa Kristo tekwali kusasula kitundu nga kwetaaga ebyaffe okukujjuliza; gwali mulimu ogujjuvu era ogwaggwa. Okukaaba kwe okwasembayo ku musaalaba, mu lulimi olwasooka, kwali kigambo kimu kyokka — “Kiwedde” (Yokaana 19:30) — ekigambo omusuubuzi kye yawandiikanga ku kabaluwa k’ebbanja erisasuddwa: kisasuddwa kyonna. Tewali kyetaagisa kwongerwako; era tewali kiyinza kwongerwako. “Ye, ye mutango olw’ebibi byaffe, naye si lwa bibi byaffe byokka, wabula ne ku lw’ebibi by’abantu bonna.” (1 Yokaana 2:2).

Eno y’ensonga lwaki obubaka bw’omusaalaba mawulire malungi nnyo eri buli kika ky’omwonoonyi. Kitegeeza nti tewali muntu ali wala nnyo gye gutasobola kutuuka, era nti tewali kirala kyetaagisa okuggyako okusembeza ekyo ekyakolebwa edda. Okufa kwa Yesu kwali Mwana ow’olubeerera ng’afuuka omuntu era ng’afa tulyoke tubeere abalamu — Omutonzi ng’awaayo yekka ku lw’ebitonde bye. Bw’oba wali weebuuzizza oba Katonda ayinza okwagala omuntu ng’oli, tunuulira omusaalaba olekere awo okwebuuza. Yakufiirira. Ekisaanidde kyokka okukola kwe kujja, n’emikono ebyereere, n’okwesiga Oyo eyakimaliriza.
